student_learning_goal: I can find the mean and mode of a data set.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can find the mean and mode of a data set.
header.character_watermark: Tally with a calculator in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Calculate the mean for 5 data sets.
parts.visual_layout: 5 data sets stacked with answer lines.

image_placeholders.description: 5 mean problems for Grade 3 worksheet, B&W line art. Each row: data set (e.g., '4, 6, 8, 2, 5') + 'Mean = ___ ÷ ___ = ___'. Examples: simple whole-number sets.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_MEAN at Part 1: keywords name the activity.

parts.student_instructions: Find the MODE for 6 data sets. Some have NO mode, some have MORE THAN ONE.
parts.visual_layout: 6 data sets with mode answer lines.

image_placeholders.description: 6 mode problems for Grade 3 worksheet. Each row: data set + 'Mode: ___' line. Mix of single-mode, no-mode, bimodal cases.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_MODE at Part 2: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Mix of single, no, two modes.

parts.student_instructions: Calculate BOTH mean and mode for 3 data sets.
parts.visual_layout: 3 data sets with mean + mode lines.

image_placeholders.description: 3 data sets for Grade 3 worksheet. Each row: data set + 'Mean: ___' + 'Mode: ___' lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_BOTH at Part 3: keywords name the activities.

parts.answer_key: Both calculated correctly for each set.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find a data set where mean = mode.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Use Part 1 as formative — count check. Part 3 transfer: instead of repeating 'calculate both for 3 sets', present a real-world Canadian context (e.g., daily snowfall in cm for one week in Toronto) requiring mean + mode.
